checkedOccurrences.text: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
Out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

wikipediaActualReadJa: 記事はRamoth-Gileadを「Ramoth in Gilead」と呼び、JOS20:8を引用して、ヨルダン川東側・ガドの領域の逃れの町と説明する。位置候補については記事内に複数説があり、この原稿では座標の根拠に用いない。
